activeConstraints: Use the current issue #421 body as the task SSOT.
Treat issue #524 and #525 archives as immutable scientific evidence only.
Do not use acceptance seeds 3000-5199 or reserve seeds 5200-5399 before the final authorised boundary.
Keep research outside production truth with one append-only ledger and content-addressed cache.
Do not create a successor issue, active research branch, research PR or research CI run; the owner-authorised publication ref is an archive-only evidence carrier and is never merged.
Preserve save and internal-ID compatibility, deterministic RNG, content validity and commercial invariants.
A negative or inconclusive research experiment is not a human escalation point; continue with the next preregistered scientific option inside issue #421.
Do not select another candidate from adaptive V33-V38 comparisons; require common policies and simulation seeds for between-level causal claims.

issue524.usableResult: Ashwarden hand-size-payoff admitted; nine local edge-aspect interactions retained; old labels rejected as causal ground truth.

issue525.usableResult: hand-size-payoff reproduced; ash-poison-catalyst and ward-mirror-edge are probe/panel promotable; the Kindle/Branch scalar, one-card and kindleDamage primitive ladder is exhausted.

decisions.decision: Reject existing Resonant Lance as the missing second Duskblade package.
decisions.reason: Both local interactions reproduced, but the discovery pilot panel ruled out the 0.25-SD practical activation target.

decisions.decision: Do not promote the partial-Facet Faultline prototype.
decisions.reason: The aspect-specific local mechanism passed, but the 128-seed discovery panel remained below the required lower-bound threshold and stopped inconclusively.

decisions.decision: Reject the one-use Cracked tempo prototype.
decisions.reason: Its local action-economy interaction reproduced, but both practical panel upper bounds were below target and duration missed.
Ordinary Duskblade attacks already Shatter, so the power had a strong standalone effect and the named producers added no practical complementarity.

decisions.decision: Admit the Scoreline and Snap Cut handshake at local and short-panel scope.
decisions.reason: Discovery and held-out cohorts passed Duskblade interaction, activation, aspect-separation, duration and reliability gates while the Ashwarden control stayed non-activating.

decisions.decision: Freeze V38 and reject causal selection from the adaptive V33-V38 sequence.
decisions.reason: No one-lever pair used common policies and simulation seeds. Acquisition priority and rarity are path-invariant for fixed-deck local combat, but no between-level whole-run effect is identified.

goal: Validate a causal strategy detector, make the exact RC content pass it, merge the smallest complete delivery and record the exact-SHA P9 pass on issue #108.

nonGoals: Do not tune a detector to live content.
Do not repeat static-exposure, old-label, Cinder Cut or Kindle-damage searches.

Do not ship research scaffolding, caches, optimisers or an online policy.
